title: Understanding the Code
text:
The line of code is using a pandas DataFrame to filter out specific rows based on conditions. Let's break it down:
- `consoles['generation'] $$==$$ 6` filters for consoles that belong to the sixth generation.
- `consoles['year'] < 2000` filters for consoles released before the year $$2000$$.
- The `&` operator is used to combine these two conditions.
- `['name']` selects the 'name' column of the filtered DataFrame.
